title.zh: IER 重新分级：哥伦比亚 COL-01 队通过复审

summary.en: Congratulations to the Colombia Urban Search And Rescue Team (COL-01) for successfully passing the INSARAG External Reclassification (IER) in Bogota, Colombia, from 7 to 12 June 2026! This recognition affirms the exceptional skill and commitment to international search and rescue of the team. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its most sincere congratulations.
summary.zh: 哥伦比亚城市搜索与救援队（COL-01）于2026年6月7日至12日在哥伦比亚波哥大通过 INSARAG 外部重新分级认证（IER）。

content.en: Congratulations to the Colombia Urban Search And Rescue Team (COL-01) for successfully passing the INSARAG External Reclassification (IER) in Bogota, Colombia, from 7 to 12 June 2026! This recognition affirms the exceptional skill and commitment to international search and rescue of the team. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its most sincere congratulations.
content.zh: 祝贺哥伦比亚城市搜索与救援队（COL-01）于2026年6月7日至12日在哥伦比亚波哥大顺利通过 INSARAG 外部重新分级认证（IER）！此次认证充分肯定了该队出色的专业能力及其对国际搜救事业的坚定承诺。INSARAG 秘书处向该队致以最诚挚的祝贺。
